title: Senior Manager-Operations
description:
**Job Description**

**Job Title:**
Senior Manager-Operations

**Department:**
Campus Operations

**Work Location:**
Sri City, Tada, Andhra Pradesh

**Reporting to:**
Associate Director

**Position:**
Full -Time

**Experience:**
3-5 Years

**Educational Qualification**
: BE/B. Tech in Electrical / Electrical & Electronics Engineering

**Additional Requirements:**
Valid C Licence / applicable electrical licence

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Manage day-to-day MEP and technical operations covering Electrical, HVAC, Plumbing, Fire & Life Safety, DG, STP, RO, lifts and other critical infrastructure.
* Manage HT/LT electrical systems, including 11 kV / 33 kV incoming supply, HT yard, transformers, DGs and distribution systems.
* Manage and coordinate the technical/maintenance team, including manpower deployment, performance, training and 24x7 operational support.
* Plan and monitor preventive and corrective maintenance and ensure timely response and closure of breakdowns.
* Manage technical vendors, contractors, AMCs/OEMs and monitor SLA/KPI compliance.
* Maintain and monitor asset records, equipment history, warranties, AMC/CMC details and lifecycle/replacement requirements.
* Drive sustainability, energy conservation, utility optimization and cost-saving initiatives.
* Handle general administrative and operational coordination with internal departments to ensure smooth day-to-day campus operations.
* Identify and implement new initiatives and technologies to improve operational efficiency and reliability.
* Support CAPEX planning, technical evaluations, procurement and implementation of projects.
* Prepare and review operational MIS, maintenance reports, utility consumption and performance reports.
* Ensure statutory compliance, electrical safety, audits and required certifications.
* Analyse recurring failures and coordinate root-cause analysis and corrective actions.
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders and support the Associate Director in overall Campus Operations.

**What we are looking for:**

* B.E./B.Tech in Electrical / Electrical & Electronics Engineering – Essential.
* Valid C License / applicable electrical license – Essential.
* 3–5 years of relevant experience in facilities, campus, institutional, commercial or similar operations.
* Hands-on experience in 11 kV / 33 kV HT systems and operations – Essential.
* Experience in MEP operations, maintenance and technical team management.
* Experience in vendor/contractor management and administration.
* Good communication, coordination, reporting, analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Experience in a large residential/institutional campus will be preferred.
* Exposure to sustainability, energy management, asset management and CAPEX projects will be preferred.
* Master’s degree / MBA / M.Tech is desirable but not mandatory.

**Key Expectations:**

* The candidate should be proactive and solution-oriented, with the ability to independently manage day-to-day technical operations and general administrative and operational requirements, anticipate potential issues and take timely corrective action.
* The candidate should be capable of analysing problems, developing practical solutions and ensuring effective resolution.
* The candidate should take ownership of critical infrastructure, maintenance and assigned operational responsibilities, while effectively coordinating the technical team, vendors and internal stakeholders. The role requires a strong focus on reliability, service quality, safety and operational efficiency, along with the ability to identify and implement opportunities for energy savings, cost optimisation and continuous improvement.
* The candidate should have good administrative, communication, coordination and reporting skills and work closely with the Associate Director to ensure the smooth and efficient functioning of Campus Operations.

**Application Process:**

Interested candidates should submit their resume, a cover letter detailing their relevant experience, and contact information
**careers@krea.edu.in**
with subject: Application for Sr. Manager-Operations

**Note: Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.**

title: Hostel Warden
description:
**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Work Arrangement:**
Residential / On-campus

**Experience:**
5–8 years

**We are looking for Male & Female Wardens.**

Job Summary

We are seeking a responsible, approachable, and experienced
**Hostel Warden**
to manage the day-to-day operations of our university hostel. The successful candidate will ensure student safety and welfare, maintain discipline, supervise hostel services, and create a supportive residential environment.

The position requires the ability to handle student concerns sensitively, coordinate with various departments, and respond promptly to emergencies.

Key Responsibilities

* Manage daily hostel operations and ensure a safe, clean, and comfortable environment.
* Maintain discipline and ensure compliance with hostel and university regulations.
* Supervise room allotment, student attendance, leave requests, visitors, and hostel records.
* Conduct regular inspections of student rooms, common areas, dining facilities, and hostel premises.
* Address student concerns, complaints, and welfare-related matters.
* Coordinate with parents, faculty members, counsellors, security personnel, and university authorities when required.
* Respond promptly to medical, safety, security, and other emergencies.
* Monitor housekeeping, maintenance, catering, sanitation, and security services.
* Prevent and report ragging, harassment, substance abuse, violence, and other misconduct.
* Organise hostel meetings, orientation sessions, and student engagement activities.
* Maintain records of incidents, disciplinary matters, hostel assets, and maintenance requirements.
* Prepare and submit periodic hostel administration reports.

Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in any discipline; a postgraduate qualification is preferred.
* Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in hostel administration, student affairs, residential schools, universities, defence services, or similar environments.
* Prior experience in an educational institution is preferred.
* Basic proficiency in MS Office and digital record keeping.
* Ability to communicate effectively in English and the local language.

Required Skills

* Strong communication and interpersonal skills
* Student-focused and approachable attitude
* Leadership and conflict-resolution abilities
* Sound judgement and problem-solving skills
* Ability to handle confidential and sensitive matters
* Willingness to work flexible hours and respond to emergencies
* High level of integrity, patience, and emotional maturity

Additional Requirements

* Willingness to reside on the university campus.
* Availability during evenings, weekends, and emergencies.
* Background verification and reference checks will be conducted.
